description: This is a C source file for the 'clar' testing framework, containing core test functions, error handling, suite execution, and platform-specific code.

classes.name: clar_error
classes.description: Represents an error encountered during a test, including file, function, line, message, and description.

classes.name: clar_explicit
classes.description: Represents an explicit test suite or test filter.

classes.name: clar_report
classes.description: Contains information about individual test execution reports, including errors.

classes.name: clar_summary
classes.description: Holds summary report data, including filename and file pointer.

classes.name: clar_func
classes.description: Represents a test function with a name and function pointer.

classes.name: clar_suite
classes.description: Defines a test suite with name, initialization, cleanup, test functions, count, and enabled flag.

methods.name: clar_report_errors
methods.description: Reports all errors associated with a test report.

methods.name: clar_report_all
methods.description: Reports all failed tests and their errors.

methods.name: clar_time_now
methods.description: Gets the current time for timing test execution, platform-specific.

methods.name: clar_time_diff
methods.description: Calculates the difference between two timestamps, platform-specific.

methods.name: clar_run_test
methods.description: Runs an individual test, including setup, execution, and teardown.

methods.name: clar_run_suite
methods.description: Runs all tests within a test suite, optionally filtered.

methods.name: clar_usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the test runner.

methods.name: clar_parse_args
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments for test configuration.

methods.name: clar_test_init
methods.description: Initializes the testing environment, processes arguments, and sets up summaries.

methods.name: clar_test_run
methods.description: Executes all configured test suites and tests.

methods.name: clar_test_shutdown
methods.description: Cleans up after tests, writes summaries, and frees resources.

methods.name: abort_test
methods.description: Handles fatal errors during test execution, performs longjmp if needed.
